name: Jin 2 Spear Rush into Feudal Pagoda Spam
author: Valdemar1902

notes: Split 1 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to build @building_military/barracks.webp@ . 1 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to gather @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ & 1 to gather @resource/deer.webp@ (reindeer)

@building_military/barracks.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ goes to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ (drop off wood when straggler is 130/150 at 0:28 and queue 1st @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@)

Remaining @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ builds @building_economy/house.webp@ at 50 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ builds @building_economy/house.webp@ & goes to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Put 1 @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ on wood during ageup for @building_economy/house.webp@ & @building_jin/grassland.webp@
Queue 2 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to start and Rally to @resource/sheep.webp@.
Around this time you should be close to Age Up. DON'T FORGET HOUSES!!
Keep making @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@and Rally to Straggler Trees
Take 2 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@off @resource/sheep.webp@and put them on Straggler Trees
Build @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@with 3 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@and stick to these until you have enough for @building_economy/mill.webp@/@building_economy/house.webp@
Can have very little or 0 Vills on @resource/resource_wood.webp@at this point until Age Up
Can make @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@or @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ if you need early army
Research Upgrade to @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@and @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@/// DON'T FORGET HOUSES
Look to @abilities/repair.webp@@building_jin/machine-workshop.webp@and @building_military/barracks.webp@depending on what you want
Can go heavier on @resource/resource_food.webp@/@resource/resource_gold.webp@for the later game because you can look for a @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@/@unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@comp

Use 2 @resource/resource_food.webp@ --> @resource/resource_wood.webp@ Use 1 @resource/resource_gold.webp@--> @resource/resource_stone.webp@  Make a regular VILL post-age up since you don't have the gold as you just spent it @building_economy/house.webp@when possible.
2 @resource/resource_food.webp@ --> @resource/resource_stone.webp@ Important to have just 2 on food, regular @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@on @resource/resource_food.webp@
Stop at 300 @resource/resource_stone.webp@, then move those 3 around where you want 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@, build when enough wood
If no aggression push for fast castle (MUST SCOUT) @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ 1 to @resource/resource_gold.webp@1 to @resource/resource_food.webp@
Have enough @resource/resource_wood.webp@to make Stables, and archery Ranges, build @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@and @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@
After getting all of your wood to make Stable & Archery Range Re-Macro Rally to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and just remacro gold and food while keeping 5-7 on wood

name: s13金朝直城
author: cat

notes: 使用@unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ 查看对面玩法
如果对面是塔爆造 @unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@保护 @landmark_jin/great-pasture.webp@
一直训练 @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@ 在@landmark_jin/great-pasture.webp@ (@unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@ 长矛换骑射)

拥有100 @resource/resource_wood.webp@, 1 @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ 伐木补草原 @building_jin/grassland.webp@ 最近的@landmark_jin/great-pasture.webp@, 然后去 @resource/resource_gold.webp@
使用@unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@ 骚扰对面村民@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ 或者防守
如果对面长矛多@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, 制造一些 @unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@
使用八个挖金 @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ 建造龙馆 @landmark_jin/dragon-pavilion.webp@ 在前面的金矿 @resource/resource_gold.webp@
所有的挖金去伐木 @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@

description:
The ONLY Jin Dynasty Build You Need To Get Conqueror by Swaggy Professor. 

For a more simple version of this build, please check out murtuk's 'Copy for me to understand series' found here: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/tu8Z6S1y6myRbMBsEfWO
name: The ONLY Jin Dynasty Build You Need - Swaggy Professor - copy
author: cat

notes: Use your @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ to scout opponent's base
Immediately make a few @unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@ from @landmark_jin/great-pasture.webp@ to defend
Always train @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@ from @landmark_jin/great-pasture.webp@ (@unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@ if you are spear rushed)

When you have 100 @resource/resource_wood.webp@, 1 @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ builds @building_jin/grassland.webp@ near @landmark_jin/great-pasture.webp@, then goes to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Use your @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@ to harass opponent's @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ or defend your own
If opponent makes many @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, make a few @unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@
When you have 8 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@, send them all to @resource/deer.webp@/@resource/boar.webp@ and build @building_economy/mill.webp@
Next 3 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@, move to @resource/deer.webp@ when @unit_jin/reindeer-trader.webp@ run out and get @technology_jin/mohe-ancestry.webp@
Once got enough @resource/resource_wood.webp@ for 2 @building_economy/market.webp@, move 2 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@
When enough @resource/resource_food.webp@ to age up. Move @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@@resource/resource_gold.webp@spot
If opponent making spears then make @unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@ if not, make more @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@

name: BeastyqtSC2 timing attack build.  - copy
author: Zubatch

notes: 2x @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ :@landmark_jin/great-pasture.webp@ start 2:30 end 3:55 and  the 2x@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ goes to sheep
add a @building_military/stable.webp@  and contiue on wood until 6
if u are against a infrantary civ makes @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@ and  @unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@ play agressive.  6 on wood is ok to spam 2x@unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@
If u are against horse civ makes only @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@
for now and then u can change the distribuition between @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and @resource/resource_wood.webp@ build a @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ and research the upgrades

10x@unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@ and 6 to 8 @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@ also @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@ and @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@. Goes for a Deer pack or a boar u should have @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and make a @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ to protect 5x@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@

name: Jin Dinasty | 2 TC (with transitions)
author: Jockxtar

notes: Move both @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ after they drop enough @resource/resource_gold.webp@ (@abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/mining-camp.webp@)
@landmark_jin/flower-pagoda.webp@ skill on @resource/resource_food.webp@ (and, if possible, on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ too)
Drop @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and build @building_economy/town-center.webp@ on @resource/deer.webp@ with 6 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ (keep 1 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@)
Start making @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ instead of @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ now that you have @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Try to not get stuck in @age/age_2.webp@. Make @building_economy/farm.webp@ with @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ if you run out of @resource/resource_food.webp@
